A QUICK COFFEE LESSON

Find your flow.

  1. 01
    Pick your inspiration.

    Choose a heart, tulip, or rosetta. Your reference stays beside the cup.

  2. 02
    Make your pour.

    Press Start pouring. Move over the coffee, then hold your mouse or finger to add milk. Release to stop.

  3. 03
    Add the little details.

    Use full flow for soft shapes, fine flow for stems. Staying still makes a bigger pool of foam.

  4. 04
    Serve with love.

    Serve early or use all 30 seconds. Your score measures how closely the foam matches the reference.

Keyboard baristas: focus the cup, use arrow keys to aim, hold Space to pour. Press F to switch fine/full flow. Fresh canvas clears art, but keeps the clock running.
